json_float_input: Finite JSON floats are correctly rounded to binary64 before any GPU f32 conversion, so shortest-roundtrip decimal scalar output preserves its exact bits when used as task input. JSON integers within i64 remain exact integers.
source_nesting: Parsing counts one level for each nested expression, block, unary or logical-not prefix, and else-if; more than 128 levels fails with parse_error before anything is charged. Evaluation counts each active expression and statement frame, including frames inside user function calls; more than 1024 active frames fails with nesting_limit_exceeded after the work done before that point is charged. Counting charges nothing, so an accepted program keeps its usage_units.
